استجوبوا (form X)
# اِسْتَجْوَبُوا (istajwabū) /is.tad͡ʒ.wa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# اُسْتُجْوِبُوا (ustujwibū) /us.tud͡ʒ.wi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# اِسْتَجْوِبُوا (istajwibū) /is.tad͡ʒ.wi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
